evidence.evidence_text: This work investigates Knowledge Graph-Augmented Training (KGAT) as a novel method to mitigate bias in LLM.
Public datasets for bias assessment include Gender Shades, Bias in Bios, and FairFace, while metrics such as demographic parity and equal opportunity facilitate rigorous detection.
